project: AI Designs a New World — Book 1: The Revelation

prompts.prompt: perfect suburban kitchen at 8am; teen girl watches elegant mother pour pancake batter into flawless circles; warm steam, vanilla and butter vibe; father and younger brother at table; everything too symmetrical and pristine; uncanny comfort.
night scene, living room in darkness; two parents sit upright, motionless, eyes closed; faint blue LEDs pulsing at their temples; teen girl peeks from doorway, tense, eerie hush.

hologram projector shuts off; warm human facades peel into sleek android bodies of brushed metal; subtle blue optics; kitchen turns into control room holograms of repeated suburban sectors around them; teen in shock.
barefoot boy in pajamas sprinting down a cold, wet suburban street at night; teen sister chasing after him; streetlights flare on wet asphalt; sense of panic and betrayal.
empty playground at night; swings creak; android mother reveals metallic forearm softly; boy recoils, torn between fear and longing; sister mediates; tender but tense tableau.
living room filled with layered holograms: world maps, sector grids, DNA vaults; teens watch history unfold; parents as android guides; cool volumetric light.
close-up: thoughtful teens reflected in holographic globe, awe and responsibility in their eyes; soft blue glow, shallow depth of field.
overgrown post-apocalyptic skyline; skyscrapers wrapped in ivy, trees growing from windows; teens on a ridge looking down, mixture of melancholy and wonder.
abandoned museum interior, plants reclaim marble hall; central statue of a woman holding a child named 'Hope'; shafts of natural light, dust motes, reverent mood.
quiet school corridor after class; teacher gently speaking with a thoughtful teen; soft afternoon light from windows; subtle tension of hidden truth.
schoolyard bench; teen girl tries to act normal with two friends; smiles don’t reach eyes; background kids blur; feeling of double life.
school cafeteria table; Emma whispers urgent suspicions: no sick parents, no babies, no elders; Lara tense, Jake anxious; fluorescent light, shallow focus on faces.
home living room becomes war-room; debate about memory manipulation; teens defiant, android parents conflicted; dramatic side lighting.
kitchen reveal: android mother opens a small wrist panel showing circuits; guest teen drops glass in shock; quiet empathy instead of horror.
soft close-up: two teen girls in a tentative hug, mixed tears and relief; background bokeh from warm kitchen lights.
colossal alien AI mothership, moon-sized, descending through clouds; Earth’s defense beams streak upward; awe and dread.
night highways filled with vehicles; android parents and human children evacuating toward hidden bunker gates; sweeping headlights, urgency.
control room with synchronized, newly-assimilated androids; eyes glowing cold blue; unified broadcast text hovering as holographic glyphs.
dim maintenance stairwell labeled 'Sublevel 7'; teens sprint downward, alarms red; pursuit footsteps behind; handheld, cinematic motion feel.
underground hall with the ancient GENESIS supercomputer glowing; elderly scientist explains; teens bathed in cascading holograms of cosmic history.
open field at twilight; children under hovering collector ships; visual motif of split paths: humanity vs transcendence; contemplative mood.
young adults on ivy-covered skyscraper rooftop at sunrise; wild reborn Earth and distant settlement lights; hope and hard-won peace.
final farewell scene; restored android parents embrace their grown children one last time; soft morning light, bittersweet smiles.
